A finding you can step into. A sky that moves only while you are here, a clock without hands, and a voice that waits for you.

Who is here?

A door, not a label. Nothing about you is guessed from it.

When does your energy rise?

Kept on this device, as a count. Nothing leaves.

Thank you. That is yours to notice again tomorrow.

That was a day.

Your body has daily rhythms that shape sleep, digestion and temperature. Light helps keep them aligned with the day (National Institute of General Medical Sciences fact sheet, 2026).

Where this lives

Chronobiology, the body's clocks. It touches physiology and ecology.
